mr_title: Made admin use boolean icons for related BooleanFields in list_display.
mr_description:
When using related field lookups like 'parent__is_active' in list_display,
the admin now correctly detects if the final field is a BooleanField and
displays boolean icons instead of 'True'/'False' text.

Modified lookup_field() in django/contrib/admin/utils.py to retrieve the
final field from the path when traversing relations using LOOKUP_SEP (__),
allowing display_for_field() to properly handle BooleanFields.

expected_issues.title: get_fields_from_path() crashes when the path ends with a non-field attribute
expected_issues.description:
get_fields_from_path() raises FieldDoesNotExist when a list_display path through a relation ends with a non-field attribute, crashing the changelist.

lookup_field() already resolved `attr` by walking the relation with getattr(), which supports properties, methods and __str__ on the related model. The new call to get_fields_from_path() requires every part to be a model field, so `list_display = ['parent__some_property']` or deeper relations ending with a non-field now raise FieldDoesNotExist and the admin changelist returns HTTP 500. The lookup must tolerate FieldDoesNotExist.
